overview_description.description:
Markaz provides an online reselling platform to help anyone in Pakistan source wholesale products from across the country and sell with a profit through their own social media stores on WhatsApp and Facebook without investing any money, from the comfort of their home.

Markaz is on a mission to supercharge the rails of ecommerce and make it accessible to masses in Pakistan by enabling and empowering micro-entrepreneurs.

product.name: Markaz Dropshipping Platform
product.description: An online platform connecting resellers in Pakistan with suppliers for dropshipping, enabling sales without inventory management.

product.name: Markaz Mobile Application (Markaz App)
product.description: A mobile app enabling users in Pakistan to resell products online with zero investment, managing inventory, orders, and payments.

product.name: Shopify Integration Service
product.description: A service that integrates Markaz’s dropshipping catalog with Shopify stores, automating product import and order fulfillment.

product.name: Markaz Reseller Support and Analytics
product.description: Customer support and analytics tools for resellers to monitor sales, profits, and optimize their dropshipping business.
